claims.content: Allows the user to generate a random password and/or a keyfile to secure archives against unauthorized access.

goal.raw_text: Allows the user to generate a random password and/or a keyfile to secure archives against unauthorized access.

claims.content: User
The user selects the 'Create keyfile' option from the 'Tools' menu in the file manager interface.

trigger.raw_text: The user selects the 'Create keyfile' option from the 'Tools' menu in the file manager interface.

claims.content: The user selects the 'Create keyfile' option from the 'Tools' menu in the file manager interface.
The system displays the 'Create keyfile' utility window, showing entropy sampling tools and password generation options.
The user may optionally use the 'Suggest password' button to generate a random password or adjust entropy sampling settings.
The user clicks the 'Create keyfile' button to generate the keyfile.
The user sets the generated password and/or keyfile to the target archive to secure it.
The user may use the F12 keyboard shortcut instead of selecting 'Create keyfile' from the Tools menu to open the keyfile generation utility.
The user may generate only a random password by clicking 'Suggest password' without creating a keyfile.
The user may generate only a keyfile by adjusting entropy sampling settings and clicking 'Create keyfile' without using the password suggestion feature.
The user may load external entropy data via the 'Load file' button in the entropy sampling tools section before generating the keyfile.
Instead of using the 'Create keyfile' utility, the user may set password and/or keyfile directly during archive creation by pressing the lock icon.
The user may set password and/or keyfile to an existing archive by selecting it and pressing the lock icon on the status-bar, bypassing the Tools menu.
The generated password and/or keyfile are set to the target archive.
The archive is secured (locked) against unauthorized access.
No unauthorized user will have access to the managed archives and their content data.
